name: Advancing Bengali Next-Word Prediction: Multi-Domain Text Dataset
description: A comprehensive Bengali language modeling dataset containing over 30,000 sentences and 500,000+ tokens drawn from 32 diverse public sources including national news portals, Wikipedia, secondary school textbooks, religious texts, and literature, curated to advance next-word prediction and predictive text.
